ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Child Process Of Appvlp.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects uncommon child processes of Appvlp.EXE
Appvlp or the Application Virtualization Utility is included with Microsoft Office. Attackers are able to abuse "AppVLP" to execute shell commands.
Normally, this binary is used for Application Virtualization, but it can also be abused to circumvent the ASR file path rule folder
or to mark a file as a system file.

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\appvlp\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\msoasb\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\SkypeSrv\\\\.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\SKYPESERVER\\\.EXE$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\MSOUC\\\.EXE$")))
